title: How To Become So Valuable AI Can Never Replace You

sentences.en: So unfortunately, all jobs are going to be gone in like the next five seconds.
sentences.zh: 很不幸，所有工作大概再过五秒钟就要消失了。

sentences.en: At least that's what it feels like.
sentences.zh: 至少感觉上是这样。

sentences.en: If you listen to loud people on social media or listen to YouTube titles like My own.
sentences.zh: 如果你听社交媒体上那些大嗓门的人，或者看那些标题党 YouTube 视频——包括我自己的。

sentences.en: And you may even get to the point of adopting the anti ideology as your new identity, screaming about how much you hate AI so you can feel like you're making a difference without actually changing your behavior, or broadening your skill set, or adapting to the new world.
sentences.zh: 你甚至可能走到这一步：把反 AI 的意识形态当成你的新身份，大声嚷嚷你有多恨 AI，好让自己感觉在做点什么，实际上你的行为一点没变，技能一点没扩展，也完全没有去适应这个新世界。

sentences.en: Because who would want to do that when you could just stay the same and do nothing about your life?
sentences.zh: 毕竟，谁愿意做那些呢？保持原样、对自己的人生什么都不做，多轻松。

sentences.en: AI isn't the threat that you think it is.
sentences.zh: AI 并不是你以为的那种威胁。

sentences.en: The real threat is what it's always been.
sentences.zh: 真正的威胁从来都是同一个。

sentences.en: You are dependent on everyone but yourself for your survival and well-being.
sentences.zh: 你的生存和幸福，依赖所有人，唯独不依赖你自己。

sentences.en: Your employer and government have their own survival to look out for, and when something threatens that sense of survival, they drop to a lower level of thinking and quickly attempt to reconcile the threat.
sentences.zh: 你的雇主和政府有他们自己的生存要顾，一旦有什么东西威胁到那种生存感，他们就会降到更低层次的思考，迅速想办法消除威胁。

sentences.en: And usually what that means is that they're going to fire you. It's human nature.
sentences.zh: 通常这意味着他们会把你裁掉。这是人性。

sentences.en: You can argue that they're supposed to care about your well-being, but if you blindly trust that they will follow through with that, you are bound to be very, very disappointed.
sentences.zh: 你可以争辩说他们理应关心你的幸福，但如果你盲目相信他们会做到，你注定会非常、非常失望。

sentences.en: AI is too big to control by crying about it, and no matter how much you post about it on social media, that's not going to stop the jobs from being lost.
sentences.zh: AI 太大了，靠哭诉是控制不了的，你在社交媒体上发再多帖子，也阻止不了工作岗位流失。

sentences.en: If the jobs do get lost, I don't know.
sentences.zh: 工作岗位到底会不会流失，我不知道。

sentences.en: That's not the argument I'm here to make.
sentences.zh: 这不是我今天要讨论的。

sentences.en: I'm just going off of the commentary and posting about how much you hate AI is also not going to prevent the skills required to become successful from changing as technology does.
sentences.zh: 我只是顺着那些言论说下去——发帖说你多恨 AI，同样也阻止不了成功所需的技能随着技术变革而改变。

sentences.en: You can't just have the same skill for your entire life and expect to do well.
sentences.zh: 你不可能一辈子靠同一个技能还指望过得很好。

sentences.en: You have to evolve.
sentences.zh: 你必须进化。

sentences.en: You have to adapt.
sentences.zh: 你必须适应。

sentences.en: There's going to come a time where you have to change something about your life, and if you don't do that, then you don't have any room to cry about it.
sentences.zh: 总有一天，你必须改变你人生中的某些东西，如果你不去做，那你就没有任何资格抱怨。

sentences.en: Now, I do want to preface what the fact that I'm speaking to a very specific individual here.
sentences.zh: 我想先说明一点：我这段话是针对一个非常特定的人说的。

sentences.en: You know who you are and these words resonate with you.
sentences.zh: 你知道你是谁，这些话在你心里有回响。

sentences.en: But there are people in specific circumstances, obviously, that don't have as much control.
sentences.zh: 但显然，有些人的处境特殊，没有那么多的掌控力。

sentences.en: And that's not who I'm speaking to.
sentences.zh: 我说的不是他们。

sentences.en: Now.
sentences.zh: 好。

sentences.en: In this video, I have four ideas to share with you on wage slavery, becoming high agency, and why all of these ideas don't mean a thing unless you fundamentally change who you are.
sentences.zh: 在这个视频里，我有四个想法要跟你分享，关于雇佣奴隶制、成为高能动性的人，以及为什么这些想法毫无意义——除非你从根本上改变你是谁。

sentences.en: And at the end, I have a short practice with six questions which may open you up to a new way of life, even if it seems simple.
sentences.zh: 最后，我会给你一个简短的练习，六个问题，可能会为你打开一种新的生活方式，哪怕它看起来很简单。

sentences.en: The first point we're going to talk about is how to escape wage slavery.
sentences.zh: 我们要谈的第一点是：如何逃出雇佣奴隶制。

sentences.en: Wage slavery is doing meaningless grind work you didn't choose for someone else just to survive.
sentences.zh: 雇佣奴隶制，就是做那些你没得选的、毫无意义的苦力活，为别人卖命，只为了活下去。

sentences.en: Now I am not anti job.
sentences.zh: 我并不是反对工作。

sentences.en: I think jobs are very worthy stepping stones for skill acquisition and experience.
sentences.zh: 我认为工作是非常有价值的垫脚石，用来获取技能和经验。

sentences.en: But whenever I talk badly about jobs or just be critical of them, there's always that one person who says you're an idiot.
sentences.zh: 但每当我批评工作、说工作的坏话时，总有那么一个人跳出来说：你是个白痴。

sentences.en: I actually like my job and that's great.
sentences.zh: 我其实喜欢我的工作——那很好。

sentences.en: Again, I'm not speaking to you, and I partially think you're lying just to avoid facing your potential while simultaneously being unconscious of your potential, I am speaking to those who understand the psychology of true enjoyment, and can't stand the thought of one third of life doing work.
sentences.zh: 再说一遍，我说的不是你，而且我多少觉得你在撒谎，只是为了逃避面对自己的潜力，同时又对自己的潜力毫无意识。我说的，是那些理解真正的享受心理学的人，是那些无法忍受这个念头的人：三分之一的人生做你没选的工作。

sentences.en: You didn't choose one third of life mentally exhausted to do anything worthwhile, and one third of life asleep for 40 plus years.
sentences.zh: 三分之一的人生精神耗尽、做不了任何有价值的事，三分之一的人生在睡觉，这样过上四十多年。

sentences.en: So I'm going to throw up a graphic.
sentences.zh: 我放一张图上来。

sentences.en: But enjoyment, meaning and fulfillment come from living at the edge of your abilities.
sentences.zh: 但享受、意义和满足感，来自于活在你能力的边缘。

sentences.en: This is pretty well studied.
sentences.zh: 这已经被研究得很透彻了。

sentences.en: No, I won't cite sources. Devin, throw up the source.
sentences.zh: 别指望我引用出处。Devin，把出处放上来。

sentences.en: I made it up.
sentences.zh: 我现编的。

sentences.en: Picture enjoyment comes from pursuing a challenge just above your skill level.
sentences.zh: 想象一下，享受来自于追求一个刚好超出你当前技能水平的挑战。

sentences.en: Not so challenging that you get anxious and not so underwhelming that you get bored.
sentences.zh: 不能难到让你焦虑，也不能简单到让你无聊。

sentences.en: Video games exploit this.
sentences.zh: 电子游戏就是利用了这个原理。

sentences.en: You take on quests that are just challenging enough because if you were a level one character doing a level 100 quests, you would die immediately and you would hate the game and you would quit.
sentences.zh: 你接的任务总是刚好够难，因为如果你是个一级角色，去做一百级的任务，你会当场暴毙，你会恨死这个游戏，然后直接退坑。

sentences.en: It wouldn't be fun.
sentences.zh: 那就不好玩了。

sentences.en: And this is the single greatest driving factor of getting into the flow state.
sentences.zh: 而这是进入心流状态最强大的驱动因素。

sentences.en: And if you can create a life structure that increases the likelihood of this flow trigger, then you have an abundance of enjoyment in your life.
sentences.zh: 如果你能构建一种生活结构，提高触发心流的概率，你的生活就会充满享受。

sentences.en: Now, the thing about jobs is that after a few months, after you're trained, after you understand the skill set and what you're supposed to do, the level of challenge just starts the plateau.
sentences.zh: 问题是，大多数工作，几个月之后，等你培训完了，等你掌握了那套技能、知道该干什么之后，挑战的水平就开始停滞了。

sentences.en: You just clock in, you do the tasks and you clock out.
sentences.zh: 你只是打卡上班，完成任务，打卡下班。

sentences.en: And for some reason you're just exhausted.
sentences.zh: 然后不知道为什么，你就是累得要死。

sentences.en: At the end of the day.
sentences.zh: 一天结束的时候。

sentences.en: I've done this when I worked at a web design agency and was trying desperately to get out.
sentences.zh: 我在一家网页设计公司上班、拼命想逃离的时候，就是这样。

sentences.en: I just didn't want to go to the gym.
sentences.zh: 我就是不想去健身房。

sentences.en: And health and fitness had been a love of mine for my entire life, and the first time I started skipping the gym was just after work because I was exhausted from doing nothing but sitting in a cubicle all day.
sentences.zh: 健身和健康是我一辈子热爱的事，而我第一次开始翘掉健身房，就是在下班之后——因为我累瘫了，明明一整天什么都没干，只是坐在格子间里。

sentences.en: It's just like the fluorescent lights above me were just sucking the life out of me every second I was there.
sentences.zh: 就好像头顶的日光灯，每一秒都在把我身上的生命力抽干。

sentences.en: And so that's the thing.
sentences.zh: 所以问题就在这里。

sentences.en: You get bored.
sentences.zh: 你开始无聊了。

sentences.en: It's against your nature and you feel it.
sentences.zh: 这违背你的天性，你能感觉到。

sentences.en: Your attention is no longer immersed in the task and shifts toward what else could I be doing?
sentences.zh: 你的注意力不再沉浸在任务里，而是开始飘向"我还能干点别的什么？"

sentences.en: And for most people, that what else doesn't involve a meaningful goal?
sentences.zh: 而对大多数人来说，那个"别的什么"并不包含有意义的目标。

sentences.en: It involves opening your phone and rotting your brain.
sentences.zh: 它包含的是打开手机，腐烂你的大脑。

sentences.en: It is very rare that a job requires you to consistently improve your skill, to match a greater challenge.
sentences.zh: 极少有工作会要求你持续精进技能，去匹配更大的挑战。

sentences.en: And of course, climbing a career ladder.
sentences.zh: 当然，爬职业阶梯是另一回事。

sentences.en: A career is different.
sentences.zh: 职业不一样。

sentences.en: You have job, career calling each different level of purposes.
sentences.zh: 你有工作、职业、使命，每个层级的目的不同。

sentences.en: And so with a career, yeah, you can advance a bit higher, but you're not the one in control of the goal.
sentences.zh: 所以有了职业，是的，你可以往上爬一点，但掌控目标的人不是你。

sentences.en: Therefore you're not the one in charge of the level of challenge or what the challenge represents.
sentences.zh: 因此，掌控挑战难度、或者挑战代表什么的人，也不是你。

sentences.en: You're pretty much told which quest to pursue in the video game, even though you want to be on the other side of the map doing the other one, you aren't working on your own projects and curiosity, passion. Purpose.
sentences.zh: 你基本上是被指派去完成游戏里的某个任务，哪怕你想去地图的另一边做另一个任务，你没法做自己的项目，没法追随自己的好奇心、热情和目的。

sentences.en: Autonomy. Mastery.
sentences.zh: 自主性。精通感。

sentences.en: Those are the five drivers of the flow state.
sentences.zh: 这五个就是心流状态的驱动因素。

sentences.en: And in a career or a job, you're much less likely to have any of those.
sentences.zh: 而在一份职业或一份工作里，你几乎不可能同时拥有这些。

sentences.en: So what does this have to do with wage slavery or being a wage slave?
sentences.zh: 那这跟工资奴役、或者当一个工资奴隶有什么关系？

sentences.en: That's a very strong term.
sentences.zh: 这个词很重。

sentences.en: But stick with me.
sentences.zh: 但你先听我说完。

sentences.en: Well, civilization was quite literally built by tribes enslaving other tribes.
sentences.zh: 文明，毫不夸张地说，就是由部落奴役其他部落建立起来的。

sentences.en: That dynamic never disappeared.
sentences.zh: 这种动态从来没有消失过。

sentences.en: Instead, it abstracted into employment, law and culture.
sentences.zh: 它只是抽象化了，变成了雇佣关系、法律和文化。

sentences.en: Society has essentially become a pyramid scheme because there are more people at the bottom than at the top, and it's mathematically impossible for everyone to be at the top.
sentences.zh: 社会本质上已经成了一个金字塔骗局，因为底层的人永远比顶层多，从数学上讲，不可能所有人都站在塔尖。

sentences.en: There's one boss and multiple employees, and the multiple employees are dependent on the boss for their survival.
sentences.zh: 一个老板，多个员工，而这多个员工的生存完全依赖那个老板。

sentences.en: So what I'm trying to say in this video is that you have to completely just leave this pyramid scheme or this hierarchy behind, not that you're going to leave hierarchies altogether, but you're going to create your own.
sentences.zh: 所以我想在这个视频里说的是，你必须彻底离开这个金字塔骗局、这个等级体系，不是说你要脱离所有等级，而是你要创建属于你自己的等级。

sentences.en: And as an aside, I have a short self-promotion.
sentences.zh: 顺便插一句，我有个简短的自我推广。

sentences.en: If you don't like me promoting myself, then just skip it.
sentences.zh: 如果你不喜欢我推销自己，跳过就行。

sentences.en: But I have two things.
sentences.zh: 但我有两件事要说。

sentences.en: The first is that Eden, the AI content strategist, now has scheduling as well.
sentences.zh: 第一件，Eden，那个 AI 内容策略师，现在有排期功能了。

sentences.en: So it is the full content workflow.
sentences.zh: 所以它现在是完整的内容工作流。

sentences.en: You can research outliers on any platform.
sentences.zh: 你可以在任何平台上研究那些表现异常好的内容。

sentences.en: You can reverse engineer them and create from them.
sentences.zh: 你可以逆向拆解它们，然后基于它们去创作。

sentences.en: You can quite literally tell the AI chat to go and search for top carousels or thumbnails or posts from any platform, in any topic, from any creator in the chat.
sentences.zh: 你完全可以直接告诉 AI 聊天助手，去搜索任何平台上、任何话题下、任何创作者的顶级轮播帖、封面图或帖子。

sentences.en: And now we have scheduling for all major platforms, so you can just schedule the content right there.
sentences.zh: 而且现在所有主流平台我们都有排期功能，你可以直接在那里排期发布内容。

sentences.en: And you can do this all from Claude as well.
sentences.zh: 你也可以在 Claude 里完成这一切。

sentences.en: I've been seeing a lot of reels pop off lately of like, oh, you can connect all your social medias to Claude and that's great. You can do it in Eden too.
sentences.zh: 我最近看到很多 Reel 爆火，说什么“你可以把所有社交媒体连接到 Claude”，那很棒。你在 Eden 里也能做到。

sentences.en: But the thing that none of those have is that now you can connect Claude to any creator, topic or post, and you can search any of them, which no other tool has.
sentences.zh: 但那些工具都没有的功能是，你现在可以把 Claude 连接到任何创作者、话题或帖子，并且搜索其中任何一个，这是其他工具做不到的。

sentences.en: So if you're a creator or a personal brand or a team, a marketing team, Eden is your software.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你是创作者、个人品牌，或者一个团队、一个营销团队，Eden 就是你的软件。

sentences.en: And we've been seeing an uptrend in perception because we switch from cortex to eat into this Eden.
sentences.zh: 而且我们的口碑一直在上升，因为我们从 Cortex 切换到了 Eden。

sentences.en: The pivoting finally seems like it's over and people are really liking the current version of Eden, so that makes me extremely happy.
sentences.zh: 这次转型看起来终于结束了，大家真的很喜欢当前版本的 Eden，这让我非常开心。

sentences.en: You.
sentences.zh: 你。

sentences.en: I cannot explain how much time and work it's taken to get to this point, but with Eden you can get 50% off your first month.
sentences.zh: 我无法形容走到这一步花了多少时间和精力，但用 Eden，你第一个月可以享受 50% 的折扣。

sentences.en: Link in the description and the next personal brand.
sentences.zh: 链接在描述里。下一个，个人品牌。

sentences.en: Bootcamp starts July 8th, so if you'd rather join that and get Eden alongside it, there's a link for that in the description as well.
sentences.zh: 训练营 7 月 8 号开始，如果你想直接加入训练营，同时获得 Eden，描述里也有链接。

sentences.en: And it's about building a profitable personal brand in 30 days.
sentences.zh: 内容是关于如何在 30 天内打造一个能盈利的个人品牌。

sentences.en: Okay, the sales promo is done.
sentences.zh: 好，推销结束。

sentences.en: That wasn't that bad, was it?
sentences.zh: 也没那么糟，对吧？

sentences.en: Most of us were raised with industrial standards.
sentences.zh: 我们大多数人都是被工业标准养大的。

sentences.en: Become a specialist, study one domain hard, get a high paying job so that my friends think that my son or daughter is successful.
sentences.zh: 成为一个专才，死磕一个领域，找一份高薪工作，好让我朋友觉得我儿子女儿有出息。

sentences.en: And since that's what you did, you stayed blind to most of the process.
sentences.zh: 正因为你做了这个选择，你对整个过程的大部分都视而不见。

sentences.en: You understood the one skill to do your job, but you didn't try to understand the system that paid you. That's important.
sentences.zh: 你学会了做好这份工作的那一项技能，但你从没试着去理解那个付你钱的系统。这点很重要。

sentences.en: You didn't dedicate time to other domains so you don't know how to build your own thing.
sentences.zh: 你没有把时间投入到其他领域，所以你不知道怎么构建自己的东西。

sentences.en: All you know is how to fill a role in someone else's thing.
sentences.zh: 你只会做一件事：在别人的东西里填充一个角色。

sentences.en: And before you know it, your ability to think is just crushed.
sentences.zh: 不知不觉间，你的思考能力就被碾碎了。

sentences.en: Even if you were considered smart and the skill you chose, you make a decent wage, but you don't feel financially stable, so you get caught in a chaotic stress loop and stress narrows the mind.
sentences.zh: 就算别人觉得你聪明，在你选的技能上也算出色，你挣着体面的工资，但你并不觉得财务上有安全感，于是你陷入一个混乱的压力循环，而压力会窄化心智。

sentences.en: It becomes even more difficult to fathom a life where you do build your own thing.
sentences.zh: 去构想一种自己构建自己东西的生活，变得更难了。

sentences.en: It doesn't even cross your mind.
sentences.zh: 你脑子里根本不会闪过这个念头。

sentences.en: And since you're stuck in the loop of one third of your life spent to sleep, one third of your life spent at work, one third of your life's been exhausted.
sentences.zh: 而且你被困在这个循环里：三分之一的人生用来睡觉，三分之一的人生用来工作，三分之一的人生已经被榨干了。

sentences.en: You don't have any capital saved up to invest in your own thing.
sentences.zh: 你没有任何资本存下来，去投资自己的东西。

sentences.en: You don't have any time or energy for personal development, and you're probably too tired spiritually, not just physically, to reeducate yourself because most of your waking life fuels someone else's vision.
sentences.zh: 你没有时间、没有精力做个人成长，而且你可能在精神上——不只是身体上——已经太累了，没法重新教育自己，因为你醒着的大部分生命都在为别人的愿景供能。

sentences.en: So that's how you survive.
sentences.zh: 这就是你生存的方式。

sentences.en: Mass replacement, by the way, is you build your own thing and you commit to it and you accept no other option.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，大规模替代的方式是：你去构建自己的东西，你全身心投入，你不接受任何其他选项。

sentences.en: We'll go over how you accept no other option but spoilers.
sentences.zh: 我们会讲怎么做到不接受任何其他选项，但剧透一下。

sentences.en: It's you just accept trial and error as your God, reality as your God.
sentences.zh: 就是你把试错当作你的神，把现实当作你的神。

sentences.en: Because that's what God is, is reality.
sentences.zh: 因为神就是现实。

sentences.en: That statement that I just said is going to be extremely misinterpreted.
sentences.zh: 我刚才说的这句话会被严重误解。

sentences.en: But if you understand, you understand.
sentences.zh: 但懂的都懂。

sentences.en: The problem is that slaves don't know their slaves.
sentences.zh: 问题是，奴隶不知道自己被奴役。

sentences.en: This goes far beyond wage slavery.
sentences.zh: 这远远超出了工资奴役的范畴。

sentences.en: We are all slaves, usually to ideology and belief systems in one way or another.
sentences.zh: 我们都是奴隶，通常是以某种方式被意识形态和信念系统奴役。

sentences.en: Slavery is about force.
sentences.zh: 奴役的核心是强制。

sentences.en: And when we think of that word, we think of the physical version.
sentences.zh: 当我们想到这个词，我们想到的是物理层面的版本。

sentences.en: Obviously, the very bad version that nobody likes.
sentences.zh: 显然，是那种非常糟糕、没人喜欢的版本。

sentences.en: But wage slavery is financial.
sentences.zh: 但工资奴役是财务层面的。

sentences.en: And if you cannot stop showing up to work without catastrophe, and if you have no skills to create alternatives, you meet the definition of a slave, no matter if your feelings tell you otherwise.
sentences.zh: 如果你不能停止上班而不引发灾难，如果你没有技能去创造替代选项，你就符合奴隶的定义，不管你的感受怎么告诉你。

sentences.en: And worse, if you've identified with your job, then you will take what I just said as an attack because that's your identity, your mental body trying to preserve its own survival.
sentences.zh: 更糟的是，如果你已经认同了你的工作，那你就会把我刚才说的当作攻击，因为那是你的身份，是你的心理身体在试图保全自己的生存。

sentences.en: You will feel that threat response even though there is no physical threat in the room.
sentences.zh: 你会感受到那种威胁反应，即使这个房间里没有任何物理威胁。

sentences.en: You'll want to argue with me, and that's fine, but it only proves my point further.
sentences.zh: 你会想跟我争论，这没关系，但这只会进一步证明我的观点。

sentences.en: So I think you get the point. It sucks.
sentences.zh: 所以我想你明白这个意思了。这很操蛋。

sentences.en: I don't like the thought of it.
sentences.zh: 我想到这个也不舒服。

sentences.en: So let's talk about what's possible and what you can do about it.
sentences.zh: 所以来聊聊什么是可能的，以及你能做些什么。

sentences.en: That leads to point two, which is the five ingredients of success.
sentences.zh: 这就引出了第二点：成功的五个要素。

sentences.en: And a previous tweet that I wrote and a quote from my book, the Art of focus.
sentences.zh: 我之前写过一条推文，也在我那本《专注的艺术》里写过一句话。

sentences.en: If you don't create a routine, you will be assigned one.
sentences.zh: 你不主动设计自己的日常，就会被别人安排一个。

sentences.en: That's how we're starting this, because most people, for most of their lives have been trained to learn things.
sentences.zh: 我们就从这里开始讲，因为大多数人，大半辈子都在被训练成“学习机器”。

sentences.en: They don't want to learn to get a job that they don't care about, working for people they would never want to be associated with in their everyday life.
sentences.zh: 他们不想学那些东西，就为了找一份自己根本不在乎的工作，替那些日常生活中根本不想扯上关系的人卖命。

sentences.en: And while I think AI, technology and social media have accelerated us to the point of understanding that there is more than the default path, that you can take your own path, because you go on social media and see people doing it all the time, that's sign enough that it's possible.
sentences.zh: 我觉得AI、科技和社交媒体已经把我们推到了一个临界点，让我们意识到除了默认路径之外还有别的路，你可以走自己的路，因为你刷社交媒体时总能看到有人在这么做，这本身就是“可行”的信号。

sentences.en: But AI giving you more leverage.
sentences.zh: 但AI给了你更多杠杆。

sentences.en: Technology continuing to advance the power that an individual has is obviously obviously more than it ever has been before.
sentences.zh: 科技持续进步，个人所拥有的力量，显然比以往任何时候都大得多。

sentences.en: And I also think that people are just tired of the sheer meaninglessness of modern life.
sentences.zh: 而且我觉得，人们只是受够了现代生活那种彻头彻尾的无意义感。

sentences.en: So for those who are tired of schools and jobs and just the default path, these are the five ingredients to becoming future proof.
sentences.zh: 所以，对那些厌倦了学校、工作和那条默认路径的人来说，下面这五种要素，能让你变得不可替代。

sentences.en: This is the answer.
sentences.zh: 这就是答案。

sentences.en: These five things are what allow you to do meaningful work, even when all jobs are replaced.
sentences.zh: 这五样东西，能让你做有意义的工作，哪怕所有工作都被替代了。

sentences.en: Hypothetically, the first is agency, which is the ability to just do things without permission.
sentences.zh: 假设如此，第一是自主性，就是那种不需要别人允许、直接去做事的能力。

sentences.en: It's to see an opportunity and act on it when nobody asked you to.
sentences.zh: 是看到机会就行动，不需要任何人来指派。

sentences.en: The second is taste, which is the experience to know what's worth putting out into the world.
sentences.zh: 第二是品味，是一种经验，知道什么东西值得推向这个世界。

sentences.en: The third is persuasion, which is the skill to get people to care about what you do.
sentences.zh: 第三是说服力，是一种让别人在乎你所做之事的能力。

sentences.en: Not to be confused with manipulation.
sentences.zh: 别跟操纵混为一谈。

sentences.en: The fourth is persistence, the understanding that mistakes do not equal death and that they are necessary.
sentences.zh: 第四是坚持，是明白犯错不等于死亡，而且错误是必要的。

sentences.en: And the fifth is iteration, the process of error correcting toward a goal based on feedback.
sentences.zh: 第五是迭代，是一个基于反馈、不断纠错、朝着目标前进的过程。

sentences.en: So if something doesn't work, you learn and pivot until you reach success.
sentences.zh: 也就是说，如果某件事行不通，你就学习、转向，直到成功。

sentences.en: Now everyone is obsessed with being high agency.
sentences.zh: 现在所有人都痴迷于“高自主性”。

sentences.en: Right now, it's a buzzword that the tech bros have popularized, and they're all copying each other because it goes viral on social media.
sentences.zh: 当下这是个流行词，被科技圈那些人炒热了，他们互相抄来抄去，因为这东西在社交媒体上能火。

sentences.en: When you tell people to become high agency, and them just doing that alone signals that they're not high agency.
sentences.zh: 当你告诉别人要变得高自主性，而他们光是这么做，本身就暴露了他们不是高自主性。

sentences.en: They're low agency because they're just copying each other and what's going viral. So I get it. It's important.
sentences.zh: 他们是低自主性，因为他们只是在互相抄袭、跟风那些爆款内容。所以我懂，这很重要。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: You have to be able to initiate action toward a goal and actually do something.
sentences.zh: 你必须能够主动朝着目标发起行动，真正去做点什么。

sentences.en: I think that's obvious.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这显而易见。

sentences.en: It's one of the traits that distinguishes a lot of entrepreneurs.
sentences.zh: 这是区分很多创业者的特质之一。

sentences.en: But it's not the only one thing.
sentences.zh: 但它不是唯一的东西。

sentences.en: The five ingredients that I just gave you have to be combined together and used together.
sentences.zh: 我刚才给你的五种要素，必须组合在一起、一起使用。

sentences.en: And so the five ingredients actually boil down into two skills, which is the ability to figure it out and the experience to know what needs to be done.
sentences.zh: 这五种要素实际上可以归结为两种能力：把事情搞明白的能力，以及知道该做什么的经验。

sentences.en: Now I'm going to play a quote from a podcast, the Davidson Podcast.
sentences.zh: 现在我要放一段播客里的引言，来自 Davidson Podcast。

sentences.en: I never watch that podcast, but I saw a quote from it and now I'm taking the quote. But it's really good.
sentences.zh: 我从来不看那个播客，但我看到了一段引言，现在我要拿来用。但这段话真的很好。

sentences.en: I want you to listen to this because it's important, and it will relieve a lot of your worry about AI.
sentences.zh: 我想让你听听这个，因为这很重要，而且能大大缓解你对AI的焦虑。

sentences.en: So anyone can build anything right now.
sentences.zh: 现在，任何人都能做出任何东西。

sentences.en: Anyone can write anything.
sentences.zh: 任何人都能写出任何东西。

sentences.en: Meaning that the barrier of entry to entrepreneurship, which is the antidote to wage slavery, is lower than ever.
sentences.zh: 这意味着创业的门槛——也就是摆脱打工奴役的解药——比以往任何时候都低。

sentences.en: But that doesn't matter.
sentences.zh: 但这不重要。

sentences.en: Look at this.
sentences.zh: 你看这个。

sentences.en: This is a graph that shows with a gentle AI.
sentences.zh: 这是一张图表，展示了随着 AI 的温和介入。

sentences.en: There have been more app releases than ever, but the app reviews and the Apple significant usage go down, meaning that you right now can go and build an app.
sentences.zh: 应用发布量比以往都多，但应用评价和 Apple 的实际使用量却在下降，也就是说你现在就可以去开发一个应用。

sentences.en: It's actually pretty incredible what you can do.
sentences.zh: 你现在能做的事情其实相当不可思议。

sentences.en: And if you don't know what to do one I agency, you just ask, ask Claude, hey, I have this idea.
sentences.zh: 如果你不知道该做什么，直接问 Claude：嘿，我有这个想法。

sentences.en: How do I start building it out?
sentences.zh: 我怎么开始把它做出来？

sentences.en: And the first iteration isn't going to be that good.
sentences.zh: 第一个版本不会太好。

sentences.en: You shouldn't expect it to one shot notion or Salesforce.
sentences.zh: 你不应该指望一次就做出 Notion 或 Salesforce。

sentences.en: Like that's not that's just not going to happen.
sentences.zh: 那是不可能的，根本不会发生。

sentences.en: Especially right now.
sentences.zh: 尤其是现在。

sentences.en: You just ask and then you improve and then you iterate and you fail and you try again and you try again and you get users and then things break and you don't quit.
sentences.zh: 你只管问，然后改进，然后迭代，然后失败，然后再试，再试，然后你有了用户，然后东西出问题了，你不放弃。

sentences.en: You iterate and you tell it to fix that, and then fix that and then fix that, and eventually you have something very good.
sentences.zh: 你迭代，你让它修这个，再修那个，再修那个，最终你会有一个非常好的东西。

sentences.en: Even though it was only built by AI.
sentences.zh: 即使它完全是由 AI 构建的。

sentences.en: But again, that doesn't matter.
sentences.zh: 但再说一遍，这不重要。

sentences.en: It doesn't matter if it was just vibe coded and you perceive that as like it being cheap, because if it's valuable, it's valuable.
sentences.zh: 它是不是 vibe coding 做出来的、你是不是觉得这样很廉价，都不重要，因为如果它有价值，它就是有价值。

sentences.en: As I just showed you in the graph, the apps go up, but the usage stays the same because the people don't have the five ingredients of success.
sentences.zh: 就像我刚在图表里展示的，应用数量上升了，但使用量保持不变，因为这些人不具备成功的五个要素。

sentences.en: They don't have taste, they don't know what to build, they don't know how to persist.
sentences.zh: 他们没有品味，不知道要做什么，不知道如何坚持。

sentences.en: They don't know how to iterate according to feedback, because this is obvious feedback that your app isn't working and they don't have persuasion, they don't have distribution, they can't get it into other people's hands, and they especially can't get them to care about it enough for them to use it and pay for it.
sentences.zh: 他们不知道如何根据反馈去迭代，因为你的应用不奏效，这是明摆着的反馈，而且他们没有说服力，没有分发能力，没法把东西送到别人手里，更没法让别人足够在乎到愿意使用并付费。

sentences.en: Do you see what I'm getting at here?
sentences.zh: 你明白我在说什么了吗？

sentences.en: Agency is only so much.
sentences.zh: 行动力就那么点用。

sentences.en: You can go and build the app and initiate action toward the goal.
sentences.zh: 你可以去开发应用，朝着目标发起行动。

sentences.en: But what about the other things that actually make it work?
sentences.zh: 但那些真正让它运转起来的其他东西呢？

sentences.en: Now, when it comes to building a software, I'd actually recommend it. It's very fun.
sentences.zh: 说到做软件，我其实很推荐，这非常有趣。

sentences.en: It's actually quite addictive to get into cloud code and just give all your money to big ol Clod or ChatGPT, but I recommend it because I do think this is where products are going, especially for solopreneurs, creators, one person businesses.
sentences.zh: 沉迷于 Claude Code、把你所有的钱都交给 Claude 或 ChatGPT 其实挺上瘾的，但我推荐是因为我确实认为这就是产品的未来方向，尤其对独立创业者、创作者、一人企业来说。

sentences.en: It used to be info products.
sentences.zh: 过去是信息产品。

sentences.en: I think small scale software will be the new info product, because the reason info products dominated for so long was because one the barrier of entry was low like anyone could create one, but two just the structure of them is valuable.
sentences.zh: 我认为小规模软件会成为新的信息产品，因为信息产品之所以统治了这么久，一是门槛低，谁都能做，二是它的结构本身就很有价值。

sentences.en: Education and knowledge is valuable.
sentences.zh: 教育和知识是有价值的。

sentences.en: No matter how much of a scam you think info products are, people did really well with them.
sentences.zh: 不管你多觉得信息产品是骗局，确实有很多人靠它们做得很好。

sentences.en: The same is true with software.
sentences.zh: 软件也是一样的道理。

sentences.en: The structure allows for a lot of value to be packed into that thing, and it's just this clay that you get to mold.
sentences.zh: 这种结构允许你把大量价值打包进去，它就是一块任你捏塑的黏土。

sentences.en: And if it becomes something valuable because you're skilled enough to create something valuable, you're going to see a lot of that pop up and you're going to be buying quite a bit.
sentences.zh: 如果它因为你足够有技能去创造有价值的东西而变得有价值，你会看到大量这样的东西涌现，你也会买不少。

sentences.en: And no, that doesn't mean that everyone is just going to come in and create apps and create software, because Uber Eats, like you don't cook your own food, you order Uber Eats.
sentences.zh: 而且不，这并不意味着每个人都会跑来做应用、做软件，因为就像 Uber Eats，你不会自己做饭，你点 Uber Eats。

sentences.en: You're not like if you don't cook your own food, who thinks that you're going to go and build an app if you don't have a reason to?
sentences.zh: 你连饭都不自己做，谁会觉得你会无缘无故跑去开发一个应用？

sentences.en: So the problem lies in the image that I just showed you.
sentences.zh: 所以问题出在我刚才给你看的那张图里。

sentences.en: You can build anything, but that doesn't mean one that it's worth building to, that people will care, and three, that you have the ability to iterate and persist according to feedback so that it becomes something worth building that people care about.
sentences.zh: 你可以做出任何东西，但这不代表一它值得做，二人们会在乎，三你有能力根据反馈去迭代和坚持，让它最终变成值得做、人们也在乎的东西。

sentences.en: And if you truly understand that sentence, you'll be just fine.
sentences.zh: 如果你真的理解了这句话，你就没事了。

sentences.en: Now, the second problem is that agency taste, persuasion, persistence, and iteration aren't your typical high value skills that you can go and watch a YouTube video about theory and tweets about becoming high agency will not make you any more high agency.
sentences.zh: 第二个问题是，自主性、品味、说服力、坚持和迭代，这些不是你典型的高价值技能，你没法去看一个 YouTube 视频学理论，发几条推说"我要变得更有自主性"也不会让你真的更有自主性。

sentences.en: The only way to practice them is to start doing your own thing.
sentences.zh: 练习它们的唯一方式，就是开始做你自己的事。

sentences.en: We still have a lot of this video left, but I hope you get the point.
sentences.zh: 这个视频还有很长，但我希望你明白这个点。

sentences.en: That that's the point is to build your own thing.
sentences.zh: 这个点就是：去构建你自己的东西。

sentences.en: That's the only way to acquire those skills, no matter what practical steps I give you later that will help and the questions that I have you ask yourself that will help you still have to just do it.
sentences.zh: 这是获得那些技能的唯一途径，不管我后面给你什么实用的步骤，让你问自己什么问题来帮你，你仍然必须去做。

sentences.en: So that leads to point number three, which is the antidote to employment, is becoming unemployable.
sentences.zh: 这就引出了第三点：就业的解药，就是让自己变得无法被雇佣。

sentences.en: Now, I remember the first web design client that I landed when I was trends or trying to transition out of my web design agency job, and they paid me $300.
sentences.zh: 我还记得我接到第一个网页设计客户的时候，当时我正试图从我的网页设计公司离职转型，他们付了我 300 美元。

sentences.en: It was a local mattress company who just wanted a website so people could look at their mattresses.
sentences.zh: 是一家本地的床垫公司，只想要一个网站，让人们能看看他们的床垫。

sentences.en: It wasn't even an e-commerce site, but $300.
sentences.zh: 连电商网站都不是，但 300 美元。

sentences.en: That is not that much.
sentences.zh: 那不算多。

sentences.en: My girlfriend just landed her first nutrition coaching client because that's what she's studying.
sentences.zh: 我女朋友刚接到了她第一个营养教练客户，因为那是她在学的东西。

sentences.en: She wanted to do 2500 bucks.
sentences.zh: 她想要 2500 美元。

sentences.en: That's way better than my first client.
sentences.zh: 比我第一个客户好太多了。

sentences.en: So good for.
sentences.zh: 真替她高兴。

sentences.en: But that 300 bucks for me was just the moment that it clicked.
sentences.zh: 但那 300 美元对我来说，就是那个"咔嗒"一下想通的瞬间。

sentences.en: I knew that if I could repeat, improve, and iterate on whatever I just did to make that money, I would somehow be able to gain more control over my lifestyle in future.
sentences.zh: 我知道，如果我能重复、改进、迭代我刚才赚钱所做的那些事，我就能在未来对自己的生活方式获得更多掌控。

sentences.en: It made me unemployable.
sentences.zh: 它让我变得无法被雇佣。

sentences.en: It formed a deep conviction that I would never accept a job again, and I would fend for my own survival, as dramatic as that sounds.
sentences.zh: 它形成了一种深刻的信念，我再也不会接受一份工作，我会为自己的生存负责，虽然听起来有点戏剧化。

sentences.en: But that money alone is just like the checkpoint.
sentences.zh: 但那笔钱本身只是一个检查点。

sentences.en: It's just the milestone.
sentences.zh: 只是一个里程碑。

sentences.en: It's the thing that made it click for me.
sentences.zh: 是那个让我想通的东西。

sentences.en: But that doesn't account for the identity change that led to me believing that I could do that thing, and the shift that happened that made me believe that I could do it further.
sentences.zh: 但这并不能解释在那之前的身份转变，那个让我相信自己能做到那件事的转变，以及那个让我相信自己能走得更远的转变。

sentences.en: So I want to hopefully provide you with two things.
sentences.zh: 所以我希望能给你两样东西。

sentences.en: I can't provide you anything, really, if we think about it.
sentences.zh: 其实我什么也给不了你，仔细想想的话。

sentences.en: But I want to provide I want to try to provide you with two things.
sentences.zh: 但我想提供——我想试着给你两样东西。

sentences.en: The first is just the start of an identity change that could lead to this snowball in your life and a very, very, very small action plan because I think my videos have enough, like big action plans, but I think it's too much.
sentences.zh: 第一，只是一个身份转变的开始，它可能在你的人生中引发滚雪球效应，以及一个非常非常非常小的行动计划，因为我觉得我的视频里已经有太多大行动计划了，我觉得那太多了。

sentences.en: I want to give you like one thing, two things to do, because that's just what you need to do.
sentences.zh: 我想给你一两件要做的事，因为那就是你需要做的。

sentences.en: And then you'll understand what to do after that as we talk about it.
sentences.zh: 然后在我们聊的过程中，你就会明白之后该做什么。

sentences.en: So the first thing you need to do is just hurl yourself into an environment that forces growth.
sentences.zh: 所以你要做的第一件事，就是把自己扔进一个迫使你成长的环境。

sentences.en: Because the fastest way to change your life is to rip yourself out of your physical and digital environment.
sentences.zh: 因为改变人生最快的方式，就是把自己从现有的物理环境和数字环境里连根拔起。

sentences.en: You just change everything overnight.
sentences.zh: 一夜之间，把一切都换掉。

sentences.en: The places you go, the accounts you follow, the info you consume.
sentences.zh: 你去的地方、你关注的账号、你摄入的信息。

sentences.en: It's difficult, kinda, but it absolutely works.
sentences.zh: 这确实有点难，但绝对有效。

sentences.en: Behavior change equals identity change because you can try to go on a diet and lose 30 pounds.
sentences.zh: 行为改变等于身份改变。你可以试着节食，减掉30磅。

sentences.en: But if you aren't a person who values health, that's not a part of who you are.
sentences.zh: 但如果你骨子里不是一个重视健康的人，那不是你身份的一部分。

sentences.en: You don't enjoy the process of being a healthy person.
sentences.zh: 你不享受做一个健康的人的过程。

sentences.en: Then you will always feel like you're running uphill.
sentences.zh: 那你永远会觉得像在爬坡。

sentences.en: You will, like most other people, gain all the way back unless you fundamentally change who you are.
sentences.zh: 你会像大多数人一样，全部反弹回去，除非你从根本上改变你是谁。

sentences.en: I don't think people like wrap their heads around that concept enough is that behavior change equals identity change.
sentences.zh: 我觉得人们没有真正理解这个概念：行为改变等于身份改变。

sentences.en: That.
sentences.zh: 就是这样。

sentences.en: If you do not have the values of the person that you want to become adopted right now by hurling yourself into a new environment and reconditioning and reprograming your mind to be that person, then you're going to regress back into the person that you were.
sentences.zh: 如果你不现在就接纳你想成为的那个人的价值观——通过把自己扔进一个新环境，重新训练、重新编程你的大脑去成为那个人——那你就会退化回原来的自己。

sentences.en: So how do you actually do this?
sentences.zh: 那么，具体该怎么做？

sentences.en: The first thing is that you need to understand how your identity was shaped in the first place, how you became who you are.
sentences.zh: 第一件事，你需要理解你的身份最初是怎么被塑造的，你是怎么变成今天的你的。

sentences.en: First, you were born into a family and culture with specific values.
sentences.zh: 首先，你出生在一个带着特定价值观的家庭和文化里。

sentences.en: You were indoctrinated with those values.
sentences.zh: 你被灌输了那些价值观。

sentences.en: If your parents didn't force them on you, you went to a school with specific values and were taught by teachers with specific values.
sentences.zh: 就算你父母没有强加给你，你也会进入一个带着特定价值观的学校，被带着特定价值观的老师教导。

sentences.en: You were exposed to an absurd amount of information that may have shifted your values toward things like rebellion or laziness, or victimhood or success.
sentences.zh: 你接触了海量的信息，这些信息可能把你的价值观推向了叛逆、懒惰、受害者心态，或者成功。

sentences.en: There are plenty of people that magically end up in this place where they're psyops into a successful life because they surrounded themselves with the right people without even knowing it.
sentences.zh: 有很多人莫名其妙地走到了这一步——他们被心理操控着过上了成功的人生，因为他们无意中把自己放在了正确的人群里。

sentences.en: And then you got a phone in.
sentences.zh: 然后你拿到了一部手机。

sentences.en: That conditioning process increased exponentially thanks to social media and our monkey brains not being able to control ourselves.
sentences.zh: 这个条件反射的过程指数级加速了，多亏了社交媒体和我们猴子般无法自控的大脑。

sentences.en: Now, there's a bit more to that process, of course, but you get the point.
sentences.zh: 当然，这个过程还有更多细节，但你懂我的意思。

sentences.en: And now this isn't bad, right?
sentences.zh: 这本身不是坏事，对吧？

sentences.en: This conditioning process isn't bad.
sentences.zh: 这个条件反射的过程不是坏事。

sentences.en: It's necessary.
sentences.zh: 它是必要的。

sentences.en: Imitation is necessary.
sentences.zh: 模仿是必要的。

sentences.en: I've heard a few authenticity bro's saying that they don't imitate, that they don't copy other people, that they don't do this.
sentences.zh: 我听过一些"真实派"老哥说他们不模仿，不复制别人，不做这个。

sentences.en: They don't do that.
sentences.zh: 不做那个。

sentences.en: You walk on two feet and you speak English and you live in a house.
sentences.zh: 你用两条腿走路，你说英语，你住在房子里。

sentences.en: You imitate because you learn.
sentences.zh: 你模仿，是因为你在学习。

sentences.en: If you want to be super authentic by your definition, then start walking on four legs.
sentences.zh: 如果你想按你的定义做到"超级真实"，那开始用四条腿走路吧。

sentences.en: Try it, see how well you fit in, and whether or not you're cast out of the psychological group that you're in, and whether or not you have any opportunities come to you, because it will probably be extremely difficult for you to survive.
sentences.zh: 试试看，看看你有多合群，看看你会不会被你所在的心理群体排斥，看看还有没有机会找上你——因为那样你很可能活都活不下去。

sentences.en: So this conditioning or kind of form of imitation does become bad when your behavior isn't conducive to the life that your core or that voice inside you is calling out for.
sentences.zh: 所以，这种条件反射或者说模仿，当你的行为不再有助于你过上那种生活——那种你的内核、你内心的声音在呼唤的生活时，它就真的变坏了。

sentences.en: And I'm sure many of you have felt or heard that voice where it just kind of whispers at you that you're meant for more.
sentences.zh: 我相信你们很多人都感受过或听到过那个声音，它只是轻声对你说：你注定不止于此。

sentences.en: You feel it, especially in a fluorescent cubicle.
sentences.zh: 你能感觉到，尤其是在日光灯照亮的格子间里。

sentences.en: You hear that all the time.
sentences.zh: 那个声音你一直都能听到。

sentences.en: So to begin the reconditioning process, it starts with your environment.
sentences.zh: 所以要开始这个重塑过程，得从你的环境入手。

sentences.en: You must become incredibly conscious of all stimuli because it is all feeding into who you are.
sentences.zh: 你必须对所有刺激变得极度警觉，因为它们全都在喂养你，塑造你。

sentences.en: So what you do is this you just flip the switch overnight.
sentences.zh: 你要做的就是：一夜之间，直接翻转开关。

sentences.en: You wake up tomorrow and you do nothing the same for at least a day.
sentences.zh: 明天醒来，至少一整天，你做的每件事都跟以前不一样。

sentences.en: You set your alarm for a different time.
sentences.zh: 你把闹钟设到一个不同的时间。

sentences.en: You plan exactly what you're going to do when you wake up, and it's not the same thing that you normally do.
sentences.zh: 你精确计划好醒来后要做什么，而且不能是你平时做的那一套。

sentences.en: You're going to eat different foods.
sentences.zh: 你要吃不一样的食物。

sentences.en: You're going to talk to different people, you're going to consume different content, everything.
sentences.zh: 你要跟不一样的人说话，你要消费不一样的内容，所有一切。

sentences.en: And now as we progress further into this video, you'll start to understand what you should align yourself with.
sentences.zh: 随着这个视频继续深入，你会开始明白自己应该与什么对齐。

sentences.en: But you have to understand that this video is also hopefully a change in your environment, conditioning you to be on the right path.
sentences.zh: 但你必须明白，这个视频本身，也希望成为你环境的一次改变，把你往正确的路上引导。

sentences.en: We don't have to get super practical for this information to start permeating into your brain and slowly changing who you are if you fill yourself with more of it.
sentences.zh: 我们不需要讲得特别实操，这些信息就能开始渗透进你的大脑，慢慢改变你——只要你用更多这样的内容填满自己。

sentences.en: Not just my content, obviously.
sentences.zh: 显然不只是我的内容。

sentences.en: Books, other YouTubers, not just entertaining yourself to death on a dopamine feed. Doom scrolling.
sentences.zh: 书，其他 YouTuber，而不是在多巴胺信息流上把自己娱乐至死。无意识地刷屏。

sentences.en: Now number two is choose a vessel where feedback is as close to reality as possible.
sentences.zh: 第二点，选择一个反馈尽可能贴近现实的载体。

sentences.en: This is going to be the most esoteric section, the least practical section.
sentences.zh: 这会是最深奥的部分，最不实操的部分。

sentences.en: But I promise you, this is the single most important thing you could ever do.
sentences.zh: 但我向你保证，这是你此生能做的最重要的一件事。

sentences.en: This is the single most important thing that you just need to drill into your head and accept as law.
sentences.zh: 这是你唯一需要刻进脑子里、当作铁律来接受的最重要的事。

sentences.en: The most dangerous lifestyle is one removed from continuous trial and error.
sentences.zh: 最危险的生活方式，就是远离持续的试错。

sentences.en: To be removed from the process of error correction is to be removed from challenge, discovery, and hard earned wisdom that leads to growth that leads to fulfillment.
sentences.zh: 远离纠错的过程，就是远离挑战、发现和来之不易的智慧——这些智慧带来成长，成长带来满足。

sentences.en: This does not only apply to jobs, where the level of challenge you are exposed to normalizes after you become accustomed to the task.
sentences.zh: 这不仅适用于工作——在你熟悉任务之后，工作带给你的挑战水平就会趋于平稳。

sentences.en: It applies to business and entrepreneurship, as well as to those who carry over the employee mindset, which is always needing to be told what to do, or always needing a handbook to feel confident in their steps.
sentences.zh: 这也适用于商业和创业，同样适用于那些带着雇员思维的人，他们总是需要别人告诉自己该做什么，或者总需要一本操作手册才能对自己的步伐感到自信。

sentences.en: What I'm trying to say is that plenty of entrepreneurs may not be engaged in this process.
sentences.zh: 我想说的是，很多创业者可能也没有真正投入这个过程。

sentences.en: This very enjoyable process that truly leads to success, trial and error.
sentences.zh: 这个真正通往成功的、极其享受的过程：试错。

sentences.en: And so to make this practical for you, the question is, how did people in the past figure out how to do the very first thing that was done?
sentences.zh: 那么，为了让这一点对你变得可操作，问题是：过去的人，是怎么想出如何做成第一件事的？

sentences.en: And I'm talking like before, how to guides and step by step processes were created that people are so obsessed with, like, oh, how do I do this?
sentences.zh: 我说的是，在那些操作指南和分步流程被创造出来之前——人们现在对这些东西如此痴迷，总是问，哦，我该怎么做这个？

sentences.en: How do I give me this step by step bullet points of how to do it and I'll do it?
sentences.zh: 给我一步一步的要点，告诉我怎么做，我就会去做？

sentences.en: No you won't, but how was the first rocket built?
sentences.zh: 不，你不会的。但第一枚火箭是怎么造出来的？

sentences.en: Was there a guide for it?
sentences.zh: 当时有操作指南吗？

sentences.en: Like if you were forced to create a rocket, could you or would you be the type of person that, just like, is scouring around for a how to guide, just to consume it and then do nothing about it?
sentences.zh: 如果你被迫去造一枚火箭，你能做到吗？或者，你会是那种到处搜操作指南、看完之后什么都不做的人吗？

sentences.en: What I'm trying to tell you is that through the process of trial and error, you can do anything within the laws of physics.
sentences.zh: 我想告诉你的是，通过试错的过程，你可以在物理定律允许的范围内做成任何事。

sentences.en: And so the successful people, they tried and they failed, and they didn't let failure convince them into believing it was impossible or disorient them to the point of indulging in quick pleasure.
sentences.zh: 所以那些成功的人，他们尝试了，失败了，但他们没有让失败说服自己相信这件事不可能，也没有让失败扰乱自己到沉溺于即时快感的地步。

sentences.en: They set a new direction according to the feedback reality had given them, and eventually they found the needle in the haystack.
sentences.zh: 他们根据现实给他们的反馈，设定新的方向，最终找到了那根大海捞针般的针。

sentences.en: They were intelligent because the mark of an intelligent system is that they course correct according to feedback.
sentences.zh: 他们之所以聪明，是因为一个智能系统的标志就是能根据反馈来修正方向。

sentences.en: They have a lighthouse and they don't quit when they get blown off course.
sentences.zh: 他们有一座灯塔，即使被吹偏了航线也不会放弃。

sentences.en: So when I talk about entrepreneurship, this is what I mean.
sentences.zh: 所以当我谈论创业时，我指的就是这个。

sentences.en: I mean, engaging in your natural state, engaging in the process of creation, pursuing unknown goals that demand failure to achieve.
sentences.zh: 我指的是进入你的自然状态，进入创造的过程，去追求那些必须经历失败才能达成的未知目标。

sentences.en: This is the singular trait of highly successful individuals.
sentences.zh: 这是高度成功人士的单一特质。

sentences.en: Failure is not a negative thing to them.
sentences.zh: 失败对他们来说不是负面的事。

sentences.en: It is a constant.
sentences.zh: 它是一个常量。

sentences.en: It is necessary for a good life.
sentences.zh: 它是好人生的必要条件。

sentences.en: It happens every single day for them.
sentences.zh: 他们每一天都在经历失败。

sentences.en: And so that all sounds great.
sentences.zh: 这些听起来都很棒。

sentences.en: But how do you actually apply this to today's world?
sentences.zh: 但你如何真正把它应用到今天的世界？

sentences.en: That leads to number three, which is to learn one of these two skills if you want to thrive in the future.
sentences.zh: 这就引出了第三点：如果你想在未来蓬勃发展，去学这两类技能中的一种。

sentences.en: And we'll start with a quote from navel, which is code and media are permissionless.
sentences.zh: 我们先引用 Naval 的一句话：代码和媒体是不需要许可的。

sentences.en: Leverage their the leverage behind the newly rich.
sentences.zh: 它们是杠杆，是新富阶层背后的杠杆。

sentences.en: You can create software and media that works for you while you sleep.
sentences.zh: 你可以创造软件和媒体，在你睡觉时为你工作。

sentences.en: So you, as a beginner, as one person, do not recognize how much power that you have, especially with AI.
sentences.zh: 所以作为一个初学者，作为一个人，你没有意识到自己拥有多大的力量，尤其是在 AI 时代。

sentences.en: And I'm not talking about the lower levels of apes.
sentences.zh: 我说的不是那些低层次的猿人。

sentences.en: I'm not talking about the people who just asked questions, and the artists who get mad at AI for stealing their work.
sentences.zh: 我说的不是那些只会问问题的人，也不是那些因为 AI 偷了他们的作品而愤怒的艺术家。

sentences.en: I'm talking about the higher level, where you now realize that you can build almost anything.
sentences.zh: 我说的是更高的层次，你现在意识到你几乎可以构建任何东西。

sentences.en: It's incredible to see people reach this realization and they just get like stuck building things.
sentences.zh: 看到人们达到这种领悟，然后他们就像卡在构建东西里停不下来，这太不可思议了。

sentences.en: And then I see them like it's happening more than in my circle, but they come into the Eden discord and they're like, like I built this thing that I'd always wanted but I never knew existed.
sentences.zh: 我看到他们——这在我的圈子里越来越常见——他们来到 Eden 的 Discord 里说，我造出了我一直想要但以前不知道能存在的东西。

sentences.en: And now people get mad at that.
sentences.zh: 然后有人对此感到愤怒。

sentences.en: They're like, oh, but you didn't spend the time and effort to learn how to actually build it, as if this isn't actually building it.
sentences.zh: 他们说，哦，但你没有花时间和精力去真正学会怎么构建它，好像这不算真正的构建一样。

sentences.en: So once you can actually see through the status games that like the tool gatekeepers or the skill gatekeepers are coming after, it's like that meme or that real, where this person is a corporate worker and she goes to this guy who's a vibe coder and she's like, oh, how's your little app doing?
sentences.zh: 所以一旦你能看穿那些工具守门人或技能守门人玩的地位游戏，就像那个 meme 或者 Reel，一个公司职员对一个 vibe coder 说，哦，你的小应用怎么样了？

sentences.en: And he's like, oh, it made like a 2 million this month.
sentences.zh: 他说，哦，这个月大概赚了 200 万美元。

sentences.en: And then she's like, oh, like, we're not even making anything close to that.
sentences.zh: 然后她说，哦，我们连这个数字的边都摸不到。

sentences.en: And it's because it's not all about the status of learning a specific skill.
sentences.zh: 这是因为一切并不在于学一门特定技能的地位。

sentences.en: We talked about this earlier in the video, and now all of this was possible before AI, right?
sentences.zh: 我们前面在视频里聊过这个，而这一切在 AI 之前就是可能的，对吧？

sentences.en: Like you could go and you could learn how to build the app, how to build the software.
sentences.zh: 你可以去学怎么构建应用，怎么构建软件。

sentences.en: That wasn't a barrier.
sentences.zh: 那并不是障碍。

sentences.en: And the people who really wanted to probably would.
sentences.zh: 真正想做的人大概率会去做。

sentences.en: And the core problem is that most people just don't understand what's possible with a long enough time horizon.
sentences.zh: 核心问题是大多数人根本不明白，只要时间线足够长，什么是可能的。

sentences.en: And the five ingredients of success that we talked about, AI is simply allowing you to do more, faster, and has given you access to the things that you didn't have before, like the ability to create software, because that would have taken way more time, or you would have had to pay someone to do it for you at an extreme rate.
sentences.zh: 而我们谈到的成功五要素，AI 只是让你做得更多、更快，并让你接触到以前没有的东西，比如创造软件的能力，因为那本来会花多得多的时间，或者你得花极高的价钱雇人帮你做。

sentences.en: Now, with that said, I've talked a lot about software, but I personally believe the media side of things is more important.
sentences.zh: 说到这里，我聊了很多软件，但我个人认为媒体这一面更重要。

sentences.en: And by media I'm talking about content.
sentences.zh: 我说的媒体，指的是内容。

sentences.en: Suppose videos, podcasts or writing that you publish once and it can be seen by thousands, if not millions of people because that, in my opinion, will be the skill worth having, especially as more people try to do it all with AI.
sentences.zh: 比如视频、播客或写作，你发布一次，就能被成千上万甚至上百万人看到，因为在我看来，这将是值得拥有的技能，尤其当越来越多的人试图用 AI 搞定一切的时候。

sentences.en: Because with content, you need to know what good looks like.
sentences.zh: 因为做内容，你得知道什么是好。

sentences.en: You still need education that AI can't give you because you haven't started the process of trial and error.
sentences.zh: 你仍然需要 AI 给不了你的教育，因为你还没开始试错的过程。

sentences.en: You don't know what to ask.
sentences.zh: 你根本不知道该问什么。

sentences.en: The value of content is subjective.
sentences.zh: 内容的价值是主观的。

sentences.en: Every person reading every single sentence is going to interpret it in a different way.
sentences.zh: 每个人读每一句话，都会有不同的解读。

sentences.en: In other words, there is no one right way to get results.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，没有一个唯一正确的方法能拿到结果。

sentences.en: Now, the value of code, on the other hand, is relatively objective.
sentences.zh: 而代码的价值，相对来说，是客观的。

sentences.en: It doesn't really matter how you write it, as long as it works, as long as it gets the result you were looking for.
sentences.zh: 你怎么写其实不太重要，只要它能跑，只要它能拿到你想要的结果。

sentences.en: And I know many people will disagree with that, but you have to agree that the point is largely true.
sentences.zh: 我知道很多人会不同意，但你得承认，这个观点大体上是成立的。

sentences.en: If it works, if the user doesn't notice any problems, does it matter if the code is spaghetti?
sentences.zh: 如果它能跑，如果用户没发现任何问题，代码写成意大利面条又怎样？

sentences.en: Does it matter if a human can't read it?
sentences.zh: 人类读不读得懂，重要吗？

sentences.en: And sure, we can argue whether or not it's going to break in the future or this or that.
sentences.zh: 当然，我们可以争论它未来会不会崩，或者这样那样的问题。

sentences.en: But still, if the code works, the code works with content.
sentences.zh: 但说到底，代码能跑就是能跑。内容不一样。

sentences.en: There is no works.
sentences.zh: 内容没有“能跑”这回事。

sentences.en: There is no set result, meaning that one, the skill cap is only going to continue to get higher, and the people who do have that high skill cap will be able to put the code to much more use because they have distribution.
sentences.zh: 没有一个固定的结果，这意味着，第一，技能上限只会越来越高，而那些真正拥有高技能上限的人，能把代码用得更好，因为他们有分发能力。

sentences.en: Because if you don't have distribution, how are you going to get the thing that you build, be it with code or with your hands?
sentences.zh: 因为如果你没有分发能力，你怎么把你做出来的东西，不管是用代码还是用双手做的，送到别人手里？

sentences.en: If you're like a woodworker or anything that you create, anything that you do for work, your life's work, your meaningful work, how are you going to get that in people's hands, and how are you going to get them to care?
sentences.zh: 如果你是个木匠，或者你做任何东西，任何你为工作、为你一生的事业、为你有意义的工作创造的东西，你怎么把它送到人们手里，又怎么让他们在乎？

sentences.en: That is the skill of media or content.
sentences.zh: 这就是媒体或内容的技能。

sentences.en: And by the way, I'm not talking about the type of content where people on Instagram are like, oh, I gave Claude access to my Instagram and it grew me 100,000 followers overnight because that's practically worthless unless you have authority and loyalty and trust.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，我说的不是那种 Instagram 上的内容，那种“哦，我给了 Claude 我的 Instagram 权限，它一夜之间给我涨了 10 万粉”的东西，因为那几乎毫无价值，除非你背后有权威、忠诚和信任。

sentences.en: Eating can do that too.
sentences.zh: 吃饭也能干这个。

sentences.en: Eating can connect to all your crap and posts for you if you want to do all of that automated.
sentences.zh: 吃饭也能连接你所有的垃圾信息，替你发帖，如果你想全部自动化的话。

sentences.en: But that's like not what we're pushing because we know that you still have to learn the thing.
sentences.zh: 但那不是我们推崇的，因为我们知道你还是得学会那件事本身。

sentences.en: That's why we're doing the bootcamp.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们做训练营的原因。

sentences.en: That's why we have the education in place.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们搭建教育体系的原因。

sentences.en: And as JC Molina says, like Saint Cash, that's his entire motto.
sentences.zh: 就像 JC Molina 说的，Saint Cash，那是他的整个信条。

sentences.en: Doesn't matter how many followers you have, how many likes you have, it really doesn't. Once you're in the game, you understand that.
sentences.zh: 你有多少粉丝、多少点赞，根本不重要，真的不重要。一旦你入了局，你就懂了。

sentences.en: But that also doesn't mean that a lot of followers or a lot of likes is completely useless.
sentences.zh: 但那也不意味着很多粉丝或很多点赞就完全没用。

sentences.en: If the trust, authority, and loyalty are behind it to any degree, right?
sentences.zh: 如果背后有信任、权威和忠诚，哪怕只有一点点，对吧？

sentences.en: It's not binary. It's not an on and off switch.
sentences.zh: 这不是二元的。不是一个开关，要么开要么关。

sentences.en: All of this is complex.
sentences.zh: 这一切都很复杂。

sentences.en: So intelligent content creation is much more than just posting rage bait to get people to click.
sentences.zh: 所以，聪明的内容创作远不止是发点引战帖骗点击。

sentences.en: So this leads into part four, which is just how to start.
sentences.zh: 这就引出了第四部分，也就是怎么开始。

sentences.en: And I want you to set aside 15 minutes here, which may change the trajectory of your life.
sentences.zh: 我希望你在这里留出 15 分钟，这可能会改变你的人生轨迹。

sentences.en: That sounds dramatic.
sentences.zh: 听起来很夸张。

sentences.en: I don't mean for it to be, but that's just what it is.
sentences.zh: 我无意夸张，但事实就是如此。

sentences.en: So you've changed your environment.
sentences.zh: 你已经改变了环境。

sentences.en: You have a chosen vessel, a vessel for where you're going, which is either content or code.
sentences.zh: 你已经选好了一个载体，一个承载你方向的载体，要么是内容，要么是代码。

sentences.en: I'm recommending content, and that's what we're talking about.
sentences.zh: 我推荐内容，这也是我们正在讨论的。

sentences.en: But you don't have to go that way.
sentences.zh: 但你不一定非要走这条路。

sentences.en: Even though if you go the code route, eventually you're going to have to go the content route.
sentences.zh: 尽管如果你走代码路线，最终你还是得走内容路线。

sentences.en: And so now you need to answer the only question that matters what is your life's work?
sentences.zh: 所以现在你需要回答唯一重要的问题：你一生的事业是什么？

sentences.en: Because that's what we're building a life's work.
sentences.zh: 因为我们要构建的，就是一生的事业。

sentences.en: We're not building a personal brand because that is just the vessel to do the life's work.
sentences.zh: 我们不是在构建个人品牌，那只是完成一生事业的载体。

sentences.en: You think of Peterson, or you think of Huberman, or you think of Watts, Alan Watts or Marcus Aurelius.
sentences.zh: 你想想 Peterson，或者 Huberman，或者 Watts，Alan Watts，或者 Marcus Aurelius。

sentences.en: They all have personal brands.
sentences.zh: 他们都有个人品牌。

sentences.en: Yes, even Alan Watts.
sentences.zh: 是的，甚至 Alan Watts 也有。

sentences.en: Even though that's not what he was trying to do, he still has one, a very prominent one, and he's not even around anymore.
sentences.zh: 尽管那不是他刻意追求的，但他依然有一个非常突出的个人品牌，而且他早就不在了。

sentences.en: So they have personal brands, but they are deeply aligned with their purpose, with their vision.
sentences.zh: 所以他们有个人品牌，但他们与自己的目标、自己的愿景深度对齐。

sentences.en: They know what they want, and they use social media as the tool to achieve that thing, because it's the best tool that we have at our disposal right now.
sentences.zh: 他们知道自己想要什么，并把社交媒体当作实现目标的工具，因为它是我们目前能用的最好工具。

sentences.en: That's obvious.
sentences.zh: 这显而易见。

sentences.en: It's the permissionless leverage.
sentences.zh: 这是无需许可的杠杆。

sentences.en: It's the contents of the media that may change, right?
sentences.zh: 可能改变的是媒介的内容，对吧？

sentences.en: If we all go to Mars, then the technology to get your work in front of other people is going to change.
sentences.zh: 如果我们都去了火星，那么让你的作品触达他人的技术就会改变。

sentences.en: But right now it's social media, and it could be the newspaper or the radio or television or a publisher for a book to help get you in front of other people, but then you still have to do the work if you have a publisher.
sentences.zh: 但现在是社交媒体，它可以是报纸、广播、电视，或者帮你触达读者的图书出版商，但即使有出版商，你仍然得自己完成创作。

sentences.en: But for the person that I'm speaking to, hear the beginner, the person who starting with no capital with nothing and just wants to start something.
sentences.zh: 但对于我正在对话的人，听好，是那个从零资本、一无所有开始、只想做点什么的初学者。

sentences.en: Social media is the obvious choice.
sentences.zh: 社交媒体是显而易见的选择。

sentences.en: And so if you learn media or content, you can really sell whatever you want.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你学会了媒体或内容，你几乎可以卖任何你想卖的东西。

sentences.en: It can be a book and you can do that without a publisher.
sentences.zh: 它可以是一本书，而且你不需要出版商就能做到。

sentences.en: It can be music if you want to.
sentences.zh: 如果你愿意，也可以是音乐。

sentences.en: I've actually thought about that a lot is like, I love music.
sentences.zh: 我其实认真想过这件事，比如，我热爱音乐。

sentences.en: I've always loved the thought of learning how to produce EDM of some sorts, and it got me thinking like, okay, well, how would I actually get on stage?
sentences.zh: 我一直喜欢学习制作某种 EDM 的想法，这让我开始思考：好吧，我到底要怎么登上舞台？

sentences.en: How would I become successful in that domain?
sentences.zh: 我要怎么在那个领域取得成功？

sentences.en: And honestly, I do what I'm doing right now.
sentences.zh: 老实说，我会做我现在正在做的事。

sentences.en: I'd give my thoughts and opinions.
sentences.zh: 我会分享我的想法和观点。

sentences.en: A lot of the musicians think that they have to just, like, post their music, and they're going to go viral.
sentences.zh: 很多音乐人以为他们只需要发布自己的音乐，就能走红。

sentences.en: No, I'm talking about the quality of ideas.
sentences.zh: 不，我说的是思想的质量。

sentences.en: That's what matters in building an audience.
sentences.zh: 这才是构建受众的关键。

sentences.en: It's choosing a problem, choosing a mission, creating content around that, attracting people to it.
sentences.zh: 是选定一个问题，选定一个使命，围绕它创作内容，把人吸引过来。

sentences.en: Your music is the product that you're selling.
sentences.zh: 你的音乐才是你在卖的产品。

sentences.en: It's not the content.
sentences.zh: 不是内容本身。

sentences.en: And so if I created this very loyal fan base, then I could probably get a lot of them to come to my shows, and then that would start to proliferate.
sentences.zh: 如果我建立了非常忠实的粉丝群，那我大概能让很多人来看我的演出，然后这件事就会开始自我扩散。

sentences.en: I was at an event, the Future Proof Summit, if you came.
sentences.zh: 我参加了一个活动，Future Proof Summit，如果你来了的话。

sentences.en: It was good to meet you.
sentences.zh: 很高兴见到你。

sentences.en: And I spoke for the first time on stage, and public speaking is my thing.
sentences.zh: 我第一次上台演讲，公开演讲是我的主场。

sentences.en: I know I do YouTube videos, but I like writing.
sentences.zh: 我知道我做 YouTube 视频，但我喜欢写作。

sentences.en: Writing is just going to be my thing.
sentences.zh: 写作才是我的主场。

sentences.en: I need to write another book.
sentences.zh: 我得再写一本书。

sentences.en: But if you think of it, that's kind of like me being a musician, right?
sentences.zh: 但你想想看，这有点像我是个音乐人，对吧？

sentences.en: That's my event.
sentences.zh: 那是我的演出。

sentences.en: That's me being live on stage and this is just my content.
sentences.zh: 那是我在台上的现场，而这只是我的内容。

sentences.en: So back to the point about Peterson.
sentences.zh: 回到 Peterson 那个点。

sentences.en: Huberman, what's their personal brand?
sentences.zh: Huberman，他们的个人品牌是什么？

sentences.en: Isn't this corporate hooks, templates, that kind of thing?
sentences.zh: 难道是那些公司化的钩子、模板之类的东西吗？

sentences.en: It's who they are.
sentences.zh: 是他们这个人本身。

sentences.en: It's their mind or worldview or beliefs or interest or experiences put in public so people can explore it.
sentences.zh: 是他们的思想、世界观、信念、兴趣或经历被放到公开场合，让人们可以去探索。

sentences.en: And if you want to see your identity live, sign up for Eden.
sentences.zh: 如果你想看到你的身份活起来，注册 Eden。

sentences.en: That's what we help you do in onboarding is create your identity so that the AI can actually speak like you.
sentences.zh: 我们在 onboarding 阶段帮你做的就是创建你的身份，这样 AI 才能真正像你一样说话。

sentences.en: And that's what users have been saying, is that Eden writes better than any other AI software because it has an identity, not just voice replication, not just like looking at your writing or your script and being like, oh, he speaks this way, know your mind.
sentences.zh: 用户一直在说，Eden 写得比任何其他 AI 软件都好，因为它有一个身份，不只是声音复制，不只是看看你的文字或脚本就说"哦，他这么说话"，而是了解你的思想。

sentences.en: And so most people love the idea of this, of building a personal brand or becoming a creator or becoming a YouTuber.
sentences.zh: 大多数人喜欢这个想法，做个人品牌、当创作者、当 YouTuber。

sentences.en: But they get stuck very fast.
sentences.zh: 但他们很快就卡住了。

sentences.en: They just look for the quick dopamine hit, searching for what's the best niche to make six figures in with content creation, rather than digging into the value they already have from years of accumulated experience and story that they think is worthless because it's normal to them, the raw material for your life's work is already inside you, buried under years of being told to specialize, to be practical,
sentences.zh: 他们只是在找快速的多巴胺刺激，搜索"做内容创作哪个赛道最容易赚到六位数"，而不是去挖掘自己已有的价值——那些多年积累的经验和故事，他们觉得一文不值，因为对自己来说太普通了。你一生事业的原素材已经在你体内了，被多年"要专业化、要务实"的规训埋没了。

sentences.en: to stop asking so many questions.
sentences.zh: 被"别问那么多问题"埋没了。

sentences.en: This process isn't meant to give you some new and novel idea.
sentences.zh: 这个过程不是为了给你某个新奇的点子。

sentences.en: Instead, it's meant to show you what you already have.
sentences.zh: 而是为了让你看到你本来就拥有的东西。

sentences.en: So take this seriously.
sentences.zh: 所以认真对待这件事。

sentences.en: This is. We're getting into the final part.
sentences.zh: 我们现在进入最后一部分。

sentences.en: I want you to close your tabs.
sentences.zh: 我希望你关掉所有标签页。

sentences.en: This was a newsletter before.
sentences.zh: 这之前是一期 newsletter。

sentences.en: Close your tabs except this video.
sentences.zh: 关掉所有标签页，除了这个视频。

sentences.en: Open a blank document just somewhere on your phone.
sentences.zh: 在手机上随便哪里打开一个空白文档。

sentences.en: Eat in, take notes, open quick capture.
sentences.zh: 记下来，随手记，打开快速捕捉。

sentences.en: There is mobile app on the phone. Join the discord.
sentences.zh: 手机上有移动端 App。加入 Discord。

sentences.en: I'm excited. I'm sorry for promoting so much.
sentences.zh: 我很兴奋。抱歉推销了这么多。

sentences.en: We finally did it mobile app after three freaking years and it's awesome.
sentences.zh: 我们花了整整三年，终于搞出了移动端 App，而且它真的很棒。

sentences.en: But I want you to answer every question below in writing.
sentences.zh: 但我要你把下面的每个问题都用笔头回答一遍。

sentences.en: So the first thing we're going to do is just excavate your raw material, because most of what makes you interesting has been trained out of you.
sentences.zh: 我们要做的第一件事，就是挖掘你的原始素材，因为你身上那些让你有趣的东西，大部分都被驯化了。

sentences.en: Your curiosity was treated as a distraction.
sentences.zh: 你的好奇心被当成了分心。

sentences.en: Your very interests were labeled as a lack of focus.
sentences.zh: 你的兴趣被贴上了不够专注的标签。

sentences.en: The system wanted you an obedient worker, so your content will only work if it comes from material that is actually yours.
sentences.zh: 系统想要一个听话的工人，所以你的内容只有来自真正属于你的素材，才会奏效。

sentences.en: So I want you to answer these.
sentences.zh: 所以我要你回答这些问题。

sentences.en: And if you don't have an answer, that's fine.
sentences.zh: 如果你没有答案，没关系。

sentences.en: Move on and let the question sit in your subconscious first.
sentences.zh: 跳过，让问题先留在你的潜意识里。

sentences.en: What do you know too much about for it to be an accident?
sentences.zh: 你对什么东西知道得太多，多到不可能是偶然？

sentences.en: What topic have you researched across dozens of sources for years without anyone paying you to?
sentences.zh: 哪个话题，你跨几十个来源研究了好几年，却没人付钱让你做？

sentences.en: The second is what problem did you solve for yourself that you assumed everyone else had figured out?
sentences.zh: 第二个问题：你为自己解决了什么问题，而你原本以为别人早就搞定了？

sentences.en: And what comes naturally to you that seems to break everyone else? Hint, hint.
sentences.zh: 还有，什么事你做起来毫不费力，却好像能难倒所有人？提示，提示。

sentences.en: That's your product.
sentences.zh: 那就是你的产品。

sentences.en: That's what you sell.
sentences.zh: 那就是你要卖的东西。

sentences.en: You solve a problem for yourself and you solve it for someone else.
sentences.zh: 你为自己解决一个问题，然后为别人解决同样的问题。

sentences.en: The third is what did you get in trouble for as a kid?
sentences.zh: 第三个问题：你小时候因为什么事挨过骂？

sentences.en: That was actually just early taste.
sentences.zh: 那其实只是早期的品味。

sentences.en: What did you obsess over before anyone told you it was impractical?
sentences.zh: 在别人告诉你这不切实际之前，你对什么痴迷过？

sentences.en: Now from those three, I just want you to stick with one answer.
sentences.zh: 现在，从这三个问题里，我只要你抓住一个答案。

sentences.en: Take one of the answers that you gave, the one that felt the best.
sentences.zh: 从你给出的回答里选一个，选那个感觉最对的。

sentences.en: And that's what you're going to start with.
sentences.zh: 那就是你的起点。

sentences.en: So we're not going to worry about your niche or your content pillars or any of that.
sentences.zh: 所以我们不去操心你的细分领域、内容支柱或任何这类东西。

sentences.en: We're going to worry about that one answer.
sentences.zh: 我们只操心那一个答案。

sentences.en: Now, step two is to find or name your contrarian spine because nobody needs another person repackaging common sense.
sentences.zh: 现在，第二步是找到或命名你的反常识主心骨，因为没人需要又一个把常识重新包装一遍的人。

sentences.en: Your content needs a perspective that only you can see.
sentences.zh: 你的内容需要一个只有你能看到的视角。

sentences.en: That perspective comes from the one thing you believe that the mainstream gets wrong.
sentences.zh: 那个视角来自你相信、而主流搞错了的那一件事。

sentences.en: Now, one way I like to look at taste or having taste is that taste represents the ability to know what is broken and not be able to pull yourself away from it.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢的一种看待品味的方式是，品味代表一种能力：你能看出哪里不对劲，而且你没法不去管它。

sentences.en: It's the ability to spot the chink in the armor and polish it up.
sentences.zh: 它是一种能发现盔甲上的裂缝、然后把它打磨光亮的能力。

sentences.en: So it's not only about knowing what good looks like, because in order to know what good looks like or to create good, you have to know what isn't just right and then make it right.
sentences.zh: 所以这不只是知道好东西长什么样，因为要知道好东西长什么样、或者要创造出好东西，你必须先知道哪里不太对，然后把它变对。

sentences.en: And that is your edge.
sentences.zh: 而那就是你的优势。

sentences.en: So answer these next. First.
sentences.zh: 好，接下来回答这几个问题。第一个。

sentences.en: What piece of mainstream advice actively made your life worse?
sentences.zh: 哪条主流建议，真正让你的生活变得更糟？

sentences.en: And what did you have to unlearn to become functional?
sentences.zh: 你不得不抛弃什么观念，才让自己重新运转起来？

sentences.en: So second, what do you believe about your domain that experts would call stupid or naive, but you just can't stop thinking about?
sentences.zh: 第二个问题，关于你的领域，你相信什么专家会觉得愚蠢或天真的东西，但你就是忍不住一直想？

sentences.en: And third, what is everyone in your industry pretending not to see?
sentences.zh: 第三个问题，你所在的行业里，所有人都在假装没看见什么？

sentences.en: Or what do they not talk about?
sentences.zh: 或者说，他们闭口不谈的是什么？

sentences.en: Now, your answers to the six questions that we went over one.
sentences.zh: 好了，你对我们刚才过的那六个问题的回答——

sentences.en: They just gave you the six fundamental types of posts that you should create.
sentences.zh: 它们直接给了你六种你应该创作的基础帖子类型。

sentences.en: All of those answers form the foundation or the starting point of a very good.
sentences.zh: 所有这些回答，构成了一个非常好的帖子的基础或起点。

sentences.en: I wouldn't say viral, but proven post that generates more authority and trust than just trying to go viral.
sentences.zh: 我不说是病毒式传播，但它是被验证过的帖子，能比单纯追求爆款带来更多权威和信任。

sentences.en: And so out of those, you have one first post.
sentences.zh: 所以从这些里面，你就有了第一篇帖子。

sentences.en: You just need to work on that.
sentences.zh: 你只需要去打磨它。

sentences.en: So that leads to step three, is that you're going to post your first idea tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 这就引出了第三步：你明天就去发布你的第一个想法。

sentences.en: And now this is a video.
sentences.zh: 注意，这是个视频。

sentences.en: This is in a course.
sentences.zh: 这是课程里的内容。

sentences.en: I don't have time to fit 20 modules into this.
sentences.zh: 我没时间把二十个模块都塞进这个视频里。

sentences.en: That's what the boot camp is for.
sentences.zh: 那是训练营要干的事。

sentences.en: But the final ingredient to mark the beginning of the end of dependance on someone else for financial stability is actually doing the thing.
sentences.zh: 但标志着"依赖别人获取财务稳定"这件事开始终结的最后一块拼图，就是真正去做这件事。

sentences.en: And actually doing the thing starts with one post.
sentences.zh: 而真正去做这件事，始于一篇帖子。

sentences.en: You literally have post ideas written down from the last step.
sentences.zh: 你从上一步里已经实实在在地写下了帖子创意。

sentences.en: So you take one.
sentences.zh: 所以你挑一个。

sentences.en: You think of how to make the hook attention grabbing.
sentences.zh: 你想想怎么让开头钩子抓人眼球。

sentences.en: You think of how to word the body for impact, and then you embrace that the first iteration will suck and that you can't improve what doesn't exist.
sentences.zh: 你想想怎么措辞让正文有冲击力，然后你接受第一版会很烂，接受"不存在的东西你没法改进"这个事实。

sentences.en: Meaning if you never post, you're never going to get better.
sentences.zh: 意思是，如果你永远不发帖，你就永远不会进步。

sentences.en: Now, if you want a little help with this, I left a prompt slash skill where you can put the answer that you wrote down into it, into the chat, and it will give you angles and potential draft variations so you can start to make sense of how it will look as a post.
sentences.zh: 如果你在这件事上需要一点帮助，我留了一个提示词/技能，你可以把你写下的答案放进聊天框里，它会给你角度和可能的草稿变体，让你开始理解它变成一篇帖子会是什么样子。

sentences.en: It will give you 12, I believe, and they're pretty good.
sentences.zh: 它会给你十二个，我记得，而且质量相当不错。

sentences.en: So you just click the prompt, click duplicate the prompt, and then you can start chatting.
sentences.zh: 所以你只需要点击那个提示词，复制它，然后就可以开始对话了。

sentences.en: And another thing while I still have you here is that the a few videos ago, how to actually grow on social media or growing on social media is easy.
sentences.zh: 趁你还在，还有一件事，就是几期视频前的那期——"如何在社交媒体上真正成长"或者说"在社交媒体上成长很简单"。

sentences.en: Actually, that goes over the fundamentals.
sentences.zh: 那期视频讲透了基本原理。

sentences.en: If you pair this video with that one, you have a lot of the puzzle pieces.
sentences.zh: 如果你把这期视频和那期结合起来看，你就拿到了很多拼图。

sentences.en: And so now once you do that, once you actually make your first post, this just like a tiny little action that at least puts you in the flow of feedback, in the flow of trial and error, because that post isn't going to do well.
sentences.zh: 那么现在，一旦你做了这件事，一旦你真的发出了第一篇帖子，这只是一个微小的行动，至少能让你进入反馈的流动里，进入试错的流动里，因为那篇帖子不会表现很好。

sentences.en: Sorry, maybe it will, but when it doesn't do well, what are you going to do?
sentences.zh: 抱歉，也许它会，但当它表现不好的时候，你会怎么做？

sentences.en: Oh, social media isn't for me.
sentences.zh: 哦，社交媒体不适合我。

sentences.en: Oh, social media is only for lucky people.
sentences.zh: 哦，社交媒体只适合运气好的人。

sentences.en: Or are you going to look at it and be like, okay, that didn't work. What didn't work about it?
sentences.zh: 还是说你会看着它，然后想：好，这没效果。到底是哪里没效果？

sentences.en: Why didn't it work?
sentences.zh: 为什么没效果？

sentences.en: Now I'm going to look at someone else's post that did really well and be like, okay, I see some differences here.
sentences.zh: 然后我去看别人表现很好的帖子，想：好，我看到一些区别了。

sentences.en: I see how this hook is structured.
sentences.zh: 我看到这个钩子是怎么结构的。

sentences.en: I see how this body structured.
sentences.zh: 我看到正文是怎么结构的。

sentences.en: Or now that you have the problem or the failure as a reference point, that's when you learn the most.
sentences.zh: 或者说，当你把问题或失败当作参照点时，这才是你学得最多的时候。

sentences.en: That's how you actually learn.
sentences.zh: 这才是你真正学习的方式。

sentences.en: Then you go and look up specifically on YouTube or Google or ask cloud or whatever, like, how do I fix this?
sentences.zh: 然后你专门去 YouTube 或 Google 上搜，或者问 Claude 之类的，问：我怎么解决这个问题？

sentences.en: What's a tactic that I can try?
sentences.zh: 有什么策略我可以试试？

sentences.en: And then you get a tactic like how to write a hook in a specific way.
sentences.zh: 然后你得到一个策略，比如如何用特定方式写钩子。

sentences.en: And then you try that and you see, okay, did this do a little bit better or did it not?
sentences.zh: 接着你试一下，然后看：好，这次效果好一点了没有？还是没有？

sentences.en: And if it didn't, and if you're just stuck in the void, then is the problem how you're writing or is the problem how you're growing?
sentences.zh: 如果没有，如果你就是卡在虚空里，那问题到底是你的写作方式，还是你的增长方式？

sentences.en: Is it a different problem entirely?
sentences.zh: 是不是一个完全不同的问题？

sentences.en: And do you need both skills?
sentences.zh: 你是不是两个技能都需要？

sentences.en: The answer is yes, but I think you get the point of just you just try and error and correct until you reach success.
sentences.zh: 答案是肯定的，但我想你明白这个意思了：你就是不断试错、修正，直到成功。

sentences.en: So that's it.
sentences.zh: 就这样。
